notes.subject: to the gates
notes.rationale: Imperative summons to the gates and doors to lift their heads — the verse addresses inanimate structures directly.

notes.subject: נשא/ראש
notes.rationale: Root-play between 'lift up' (נָשָׂא) and 'your heads' (רֹאשֵׁיכֶם) — same consonants resh-aleph-shin rearranged; lost in Guaraní.

notes.subject: הכבוד
notes.rationale: Literally 'the weighty/heavy one' — figurative splendor; 'heavy' sense lost in any natural-language rendering.

notes.subject: עולם
notes.rationale: 'Everlasting' vs 'ancient' — both read the vanishing-point metaphor; 'opa ára oikóva hína' leans everlasting.

translation: Eñemongakuaa, okarahái, pe akãguasu; peñemongakuaa jey, yvága rokẽita oikóva hína opa ára; ha oikéta Ñandejára — Jahve — mburuvicha tuichavéva kuarahy rehechaukáva.
